brief: Course cards on the dashboard need a footer with two actions: "Continue" (the main thing to do with that course) and "Details". There can be a dozen of these cards on one page. How should this be built?

recordPatterns.reason: the card's lead action is neutral, never accent (Button card-actions pattern)
